title: Decision on Appropriate Strategy for Urban Wildlife Management
what_it_is: Decision on Appropriate Strategy for Urban Wildlife Management

sections.label: Urban wildlife management framework question
sections.summary: Asked what framework decides urban wildlife management strategy and what factors determine the approach for different species.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development in light of the decision by NParks to put down the saltwater crocodile found near Marina East Drive (a) what is the framework in place to decide on the appropriate strategy for urban wildlife management; and (b) what factors determine the relevant approach for different species of wildlife.

sections.label: Crocodile risk at East Coast Park
sections.summary: East Coast Park receives 7.5 million visits a year, and the crocodile was assessed to pose a significant risk to public safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As East Coast Park is a popular destination that receives 7.5 million visits a year, the assessment was that the crocodile posed a significant risk to public safety.

sections.label: Crocodile euthanised for public safety
sections.summary: With no feasible option for relocation or rehoming, NParks had to euthanise the crocodile in the interest of public safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As there was no feasible option for relocation or rehoming, NParks had to euthanise the crocodile in the interest of public safety.

sections.label: NParks wildlife monitoring and collaborations
sections.summary: NParks agrees with Dr Shawn Lum, will monitor and manage local wildlife populations, and deepen collaborations to promote safe human-wildlife encounters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks agrees with Dr Shawn Lum, Senior Lecturer from the Nanyang Technological University and former President of the Nature Society (Singapore), who wrote an opinion piece in The Straits Times on 27 October 2023, and I quote him: "We need both a system and a culture for dealing with the joys and risks that come with having beautiful and majestic wild neighbours."  To this end, NParks will continue to monitor and carefully manage the populations of local wildlife species to safeguard public health and safety.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will also deepen its collaborations with partners such as the nature community and youth leaders from the Youth Stewards for Nature programme, to promote safe and responsible human-wildlife encounters in our City in Nature.

sections.label: Quick trapping and rehoming options
sections.summary: The crocodile had to be trapped quickly once sighted, but options to rehome or relocate it were actively explored.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In the case of this crocodile, we had to move rather quickly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Once it was sighted, we had to quickly trap it to make sure that the area was safe for the public.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: But we actively reached out and explored various options to rehome or relocate the crocodile.
